svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.20.12.1 Corbelling
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.20 MASONRY AND INSULATING CONCRETE FORM WALLS NOT IN CONTACT WITH THE GROUND

g.text: Corbelled units are solid masonry units, (1)
Each unit projects not more than 25 mm (1″), and
the total projection is not more than one third
of the total wall thickness T, (2)
190 / 3 = 63.3 mm, two courses of 25 mm = 50 mm
Solid masonry unit: used for corbelling, (1)
Hollow unit with open cores: not used

svg.text: All corbelling consists of solid masonry
The units are corbelled so that the horizontal
projection of any unit does not exceed 25 mm
and the total projection does not exceed one
third of the total wall thickness.
Drawn: A wall cut through, solid brick units, mortar joints 10 mm. B and C single units.
